entities.summary: Wilhelm Rudolf Mann was a German business executive for IG Farben and later with Bayer. He was a supporter and member of the Nazi Party, and was involved in financing the human medical experiments of Josef Mengele at Auschwitz. Following the end of the Second World War, Mann was indicted for war crimes and crimes against humanity in the IG Farben trial, but he was acquitted in 1948.
